_comment: Settings for local development with the test harness (run.py): the Web App's settings plus the mock Core API's (mock_*). The Web App container uses web_app/config/settings.json instead. Environment variables override these (see dev_settings.py). Users/auth are a development placeholder (gap G-6). core-gateway is the service user the mock Core API signs in as when it forwards Core API calls to the Web App; it is hidden from the sign-in picker.
